text:
Type: large tribal medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a large seating area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, bohemian, rustic
Materials: low flat pile, woven fibers
Colors: cream, burgundy red, warm brown, multicolor accents
Shape: rectangular, three stacked geometric medallions on cream field, scattered tribal motifs, multiple red patterned borders, large and bold
Feel: vibrant, warm, lively, cultural
Goes with: light wood floors, white or cream sofas, neutral walls; bohemian, farmhouse or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Opulence Rug, 8' x 10', Burgundy
product.description: Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Cotton Imported Get the look of classic opulence with modern durability in this Oriental-style rug. Its rich burgundy tones highlight an intricate geometric border that frames a traditional medallion pattern, finished with fringe for a timeless look. Traditional design with contemporary functionality Machine woven. Made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene Exceptionally durable for busy households 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
